draft_statement: Draft core: identify these leading displayed joint-curve differences: Hip GVS 4.77 degrees; Ankle GVS 4.05 degrees. Choose which joints actually deserve emphasis; ranking is not clinical severity.
evidence:

draft_statement: Draft core: describe Rectus femoris (RF) as above the phase-specific reference mean at about 66% of the analysis cycle, with displayed max |z| 3.5. Decide whether it merits inclusion or replace it with a more relevant input-supported finding.
evidence: - RF: above-threshold interval(s) 52%-71%; 95%-24% (wraps cycle boundary), 47% of cycle above threshold, above threshold across cycle boundary, peak normalized amplitude 0.66, max |z| vs healthy reference: 3.5 (above reference, at 66% of cycle)
proposed_components: Muscle AND mean-relative direction AND approximate cycle location; magnitude provides descriptive context, not a diagnostic threshold.
selection_basis: One of two largest displayed max-|z| values; alphabetical tie-break only selects a review candidate. No uniqueness or exact rank is required.
